rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant may perform one of several alternative actions: Model each stated action as an activity on its corresponding decision branch; do not represent the actions only as alternative end events.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant may perform one of several alternative actions.

rules.instruction: Use bpmn:sendTask or bpmn:receiveTask when sending or waiting for a message is itself the modeled unit of work.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant sends information or a document to another participant
